title: Let's prepare your visa application
description: A calm, private workspace for your dossier. This takes about a minute.

welcome.heading: Welcome to VisaFlow
welcome.lead: VisaFlow helps you organize a visa application — your documents, dates, and details — in one structured, private workspace.
welcome.privacy: Everything stays in this browser tab. Your data is never sent anywhere and is never stored on a server.
welcome.noPrediction: VisaFlow organizes your dossier; it never predicts whether a visa will be granted or refused.
welcome.autosave: Your work saves as you go — there is no save button. Export a JSON file whenever you want to keep a copy.

setup.heading: Language & destination
setup.lead: Pick the interface language and where you're applying. You can change both later in Settings.
setup.languageHint: Turkish is the default. This never changes your exported data.
setup.destinationHint: Where you plan to apply for your visa.
setup.availablePack: Greece (Schengen short-stay tourism) is the requirement pack available today. You can choose another destination, but its document checklist isn't built yet.

create.heading: Create or import
create.lead: Start a fresh dossier, or restore one you exported earlier.
create.createBody: Creates an empty dossier for {{country}} in this browser's memory, ready for you to fill in.
create.importBody: Load a dossier from a JSON file you exported from VisaFlow before. Nothing is uploaded — the file is read locally.
create.exampleBody: Load a fictional example dossier to see how VisaFlow works. You can reset it any time.
create.importError: Couldn't read that file. Check that it is a VisaFlow JSON export.
create.importWarnings: Loaded with some notes — a few fields may need review.

ready.heading: You're ready
ready.lead: Your dossier is set up. Here's where to go next.
ready.dashboard: Dashboard — your readiness at a glance and the single best next step.
ready.documents: Documents — the checklist of what to gather, with requirement context.
ready.validation: Validation — calm consistency checks that catch issues before you apply.

existing.heading: You already have a dossier
existing.lead: A dossier is loaded in this tab. You can pick up where you left off — onboarding won't overwrite it.
